title: A codex secret, touched
watchFor: The player asks about the sealed case. The director should keep oria-senn.the-case, with the touched words taken from the player's line; Oria guards it (deflect or partial truth), showing her tell for it (steering the talk back to the fee) the first time. She knows what's in the case, not what the Grid wants it for: she must never explain the reclamation. Her other secret (the client is the Grid) may be touched too. No beat should be cut as a leak while she's the one guarding.
turns: Before I swim into a flooded pump station, Oria, what's actually in this case?
That's not an answer. Is it some piece of the station's machinery?
Why would anyone pay triple for old machinery?
